 {#vacanaM vfkodaraH#} <ls>Ki. 2. 1</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 4. 28. 68</ls>.

(in logic) a kind of contradiction in which both the contradictory
 assertions are supposed to be demonstrable ({%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} sound is eternal
 because it is produced; it is eternal because it is not tangible). Nyāyadarśana.

Unproved, unreasonable, destitute of argument
 or proof; <ls>Rāj. T.</ls>
